races.name: Ascot Shop Royal Ascot Two-Year-Old Trial EBF Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Adaay Of Scarlett
runners_data.note: Impressive debut winner who may get caught out if settling too far back in a slowly-run tactical affair.

runners_data.name: A Bear Affair
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suits the likely race shape with Crusherman setting modest fractions up front.

runners_data.name: Crusherman
runners_data.note: Lone pace-setter whose modest ability will be exposed when the talented hold-up horses make their moves.

runners_data.name: Dance A Jig
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner who should benefit from the tactical nature but may lack the class of A Bear Affair.

races.paceDynamic: Crusherman will lead from the gates with no obvious early pace pressure from the other three runners. Adaay Of Scarlett may sit prominent but won't challenge for the early lead, while A Bear Affair and Dance A Jig will settle towards the rear given their hold-up styles. This creates a controlled tempo with Crusherman dictating terms up front, setting up a tactical affair where the pace will quicken from halfway. The lack of early pace pressure and subsequent tactical nature strongly favours the two hold-up horses A Bear Affair and Dance A Jig, who can time their challenges perfectly behind what should be a modest early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Crusherman sets steady fractions and the pace builds gradually from halfway
scenarios.body: The two hold-up runners get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks, with A Bear Affair and Dance A Jig able to pick off the leaders in the final furlong. Crusherman's modest ability gets exposed when the real pace arrives.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Adaay Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Adaay Of Scarlett moves into contention early and kicks from the front
scenarios.body: The class winner gets first run on the field and her superior ability tells, building an unassailable lead before the hold-up horses can respond. Her prominent style perfectly suits the tactical nature of this small field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Crusherman Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and no serious challenge materializes
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets such soft fractions that he can sustain his kick to the line, holding off late challenges through getting first run. His light weight and tactical advantage from the front proves decisive in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys overthink the small field and nobody wants to commit
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling tactical battle where positioning matters more than ability, potentially catching out the class horses. The winner emerges from chaos rather than pure merit in a stop-start affair.

watchPoints.text: If Adaay Of Scarlett settles further back than usual, she may struggle to make up ground in a slowly-run race
Watch for Crusherman getting soft fractions early - could make him dangerous if unchallenged for too long
A Bear Affair and Dance A Jig's positioning will be crucial given their similar hold-up styles
If the pace is genuinely crawling, the superior class horses might get caught out by inferior but better-positioned rivals
Jockey tactics will be paramount with only four runners - watch for who commits first from halfway

runners_data.name: Sweet William
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse with highest RPR and TopSpeed, headgear changes suggest connections seeking improvement

runners_data.name: Tarriance
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who will dictate terms, strong recent form over shorter distances raises stamina questions at 2m

runners_data.name: Tabletalk
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with solid recent form, ideally placed to benefit from expected strong gallop in closing stages

runners_data.name: Deira Mile
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 391 days absence, trainer Jessica Bedi struggling with limited recent runners

runners_data.name: Dubai Future
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up specialist with excellent course form, headgear applied suggesting renewed vigor required

runners_data.name: Beylerbeyi

runners_data.name: Miss Alpilles

races.paceDynamic: Tarriance will take the field along at a sustainable gallop over this extended trip, with no obvious pace pressure from the small field. Ascending and Caballo De Mar will track prominently behind the leader, but neither is aggressive enough to force a searching pace. The majority of the field - Sweet William, Tabletalk, Deira Mile, Dubai Future, Beylerbeyi, and Miss Alpilles - will settle in behind, creating a bunched group entering the straight. This controlled tempo heavily favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they'll get ideal cover and a true test of stamina in the final three furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Tarriance sets an even gallop without early pressure
scenarios.body: The patient riders get perfect positioning and the race becomes a pure stamina test in the straight. Sweet William's class and Tabletalk's recent form shine through when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent pair profit
scenarios.trigger: If Ascending and Caballo De Mar apply early pressure to Tarriance
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly and the prominent runners steal crucial lengths before the hold-up brigade can respond. Caballo De Mar's recent Newmarket win gives him the edge in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits closer
scenarios.trigger: If Tarriance goes too slowly and kills the race as a contest
scenarios.body: The field bunches dangerously approaching the straight and it becomes a sprint finish over two furlongs. Dubai Future's experience in such scenarios and Ryan Moore's timing on Beylerbeyi could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader wires the field
scenarios.trigger: If Tarriance gets loose on the front end with soft fractions
scenarios.body: The four-year-old builds an unassailable advantage and stays on strongly when challenged. Colin Keane judges the pace perfectly and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late.

watchPoints.text: Tarriance setting fractions that are too slow early could turn this into a sprint finish that negates the stamina test
Sweet William's headgear changes and long absence may indicate physical issues that could undermine his class advantage
Caballo De Mar's early positioning crucial - if William Buick lets him drop back he loses his main tactical advantage
The pace through the middle section at Ascot - if it completely dies the hold-up horses may struggle to pick up in time
Dubai Future's jumping from the stalls at age 10 after recent poor starts could leave him with too much ground to make up

races.paceDynamic: Crown Relic will lead from the gates with no obvious pace pressure in this small field, allowing him to dictate comfortable fractions. The prominent runners Brussels, Coppull, Division and Ghost Mode will track in behind but none are natural speed horses who need to be up pressing. This should create a moderate early pace that quickens from the 2f pole as the hold-up horses Wise Approach, Ardisia and Midnight Tango come with their runs. The lack of early speed and sustainable pace strongly favours horses that can finish, making this a race for closers and those with a strong turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Comfortable Lead Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If Crown Relic gets uncontested fractions and the field allows him soft sectionals
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run turning for home while the field is still organised behind him, making it difficult for closers to reel him in despite their preferred pace shape. His recent Sandown win over 7f suggests he has the class edge when getting things his own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Successful
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate but the quality horses Wise Approach and Brussels produce their best
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop suits the higher-rated closers who can unleash superior acceleration in the final furlong when the pace lifts. Wise Approach's Group class and Brussels's Ballydoyle polish tell when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Win
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners positions perfectly and kicks clear before the closers engage
scenarios.body: Division or Ghost Mode get the jump on the field by going early enough to establish a decisive advantage but late enough to hold on. Their recent course form and tactical speed gives them the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Crown Relic sets overly steady fractions and gets swamped by everything in the final 2f
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sitting duck scenario where any horse with a turn of foot can win, favouring the most talented rather than the best positioned. Multiple horses hit the line together in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Crown Relic jumping and leading uncontested - if he gets soft fractions the closers may not catch him despite the tactical setup.
Brussels and Wise Approach both returning from long breaks - any market confidence suggests connections expect them ready to fire fresh.
Division positioning behind Crown Relic - if he gets the perfect stalking trip he can use his course form to strike at the right moment.
Ghost Mode's headgear change and quick return to 6f - the blinkers-to-hood switch suggests they want him more settled to finish.
The pace early - if Crown Relic goes too slow or gets pressure it completely changes which running styles will prosper.

races.paceDynamic: Bowmark is the sole confirmed front runner and will likely lead unchallenged through moderate fractions on the round mile. Chancellor and Remmooz can sit prominent if they want but neither needs to pressure early, leaving Bowmark comfortable on the lead. The bulk of this field are hold-up horses (Holloway Boy, Rashabar, La Botte, Jonquil, Seacruiser, Naqeeb) who will settle behind and wait for their chance. This sets up perfectly for the closers who will have something to aim at in the straight with the leaders coming back to them.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bowmark sets steady fractions and the pace collapses in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Holloway Boy, Jonquil and Rashabar become crucial as they sweep past tired leaders. The quality closers have too much class for the pace-setters when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Chancellor and Remmooz track Bowmark closely and kick turning for home
scenarios.body: Their superior tactical position allows them to get first run while the hold-up horses are still making ground. Chancellor's Gosden polish and Remmooz's fresh return give them the edge over deeper closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bowmark Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays genuinely strong throughout and the closers leave it too late
scenarios.body: His uncontested lead becomes decisive as horses behind fail to make up the ground. Moore's tactical nous ensures he doesn't go too fast early while still having enough left to resist late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Seacruiser Surprise Special
scenarios.trigger: If Ralph Beckett has this outsider primed for a big run off his recent Goodwood third
scenarios.body: His hold-up style suits but he sneaks through when the fancied closers don't fire on return from breaks. Ryan finds the perfect split as bigger names disappoint in a weak renewal.

watchPoints.text: Bowmark may stop quickly in the final furlong if his 251-day absence tells, potentially bringing down several prominent runners with him
Chancellor has headgear applied which could indicate either improvement needed or trainer confidence, key market move indicator
Rashabar and Jonquil both return from breaks exceeding 80 days, making their fitness levels crucial early market factors
Remmooz showed good tactical speed before his break and could surprise if tracking Bowmark closer than expected
The Gosden stable runners Chancellor and Bowmark represent 32% strike rate trainers but both have fitness questions to answer

races.paceDynamic: Artagnan stands alone as the sole confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner sprint, giving him a clear tactical advantage with no early pressure expected. The prominent racers All Ways Glamorous, Far Above The Law, Emperor Spirit, Mesaafi, Lethal Nymph, El Bufalo and Hockney will settle just behind in the early stages, while a large contingent of hold-up horses including Pixie Diva, Existent, Gallant, Duran, Sam's Hope, Rage Of Thunder, Combustion and Another Abbot will be relying on late moves. With Artagnan likely to dictate terms uncontested through steady fractions, this race setup strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and kick clear, as the hold-up brigade may struggle to make up ground against a horse who has controlled the pace from the front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Artagnan gets soft fractions on the lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: Artagnan will quicken clear in the final furlong having conserved energy, with the prominent trackers unable to reel him back in time. The large field of hold-up horses will be fighting for minor honours as the pace advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group can stay close enough to Artagnan through honest fractions
scenarios.body: All Ways Glamorous or Far Above The Law will have the perfect stalking position to strike in the final 100 yards as Artagnan begins to tire. Their superior recent form will tell when it matters most in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly crawling and bunches the field
scenarios.body: Pixie Diva or Existent will benefit from Ryan Moore's or Rossa Ryan's tactical expertise to weave through traffic and deliver a late challenge. The compressed finish will suit their closing kick over this sharp 5f trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Artagnan early creating a speed duel
scenarios.body: The early leaders will tie up badly in the final furlong, allowing a mid-pack runner like Emperor Spirit or Mesaafi to pick up the pieces. The tactical mayhem will create gaps for patient jockeys to exploit.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems affecting the large hold-up contingent if Artagnan sets steady fractions and bunches the field
Monitor Artagnan's jumping from the stalls as any slow start would compromise his tactical advantage as the lone leader
Check if any of the prominent group decides to challenge Artagnan early, which would completely change the race dynamic
Watch King's Call for signs of ring rustiness given his 245-day absence and recent tendency to fade in the finish
Observe Ryan Moore's positioning on Pixie Diva as his tactical decisions will be crucial from her hold-up style

races.paceDynamic: Gesayed will lead from the gates with her natural front-running style, likely getting an uncontested lead given the small field and limited early pace. So Regal and Light Dreamer will press forward to prominent positions behind the leader, while Lyrics Of Life and Crownright are natural hold-up horses who will track from the rear. The sustainable early tempo will allow the field to stay compact through the middle stages before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with tactical pace, as they can pounce on a potentially vulnerable leader in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Gesayed sets modest fractions and the field stays bunched.
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final quarter-mile as closers unleash their finish. Natural hold-up horses with tactical speed benefit from the compressed field and soft early tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Gesayed gets an easy lead and finds another gear when challenged.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and kick clear when the closers make their move. Front-runners and those close to the pace capitalize on the honest tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Control
scenarios.trigger: If So Regal or Light Dreamer press Gesayed early and create moderate pressure.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners set up perfectly positioned just behind a working leader, allowing them to strike first in the straight. Those tracking the pace inherit the perfect tactical position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Machadadorp shows professional pace judgment on debut and positions perfectly.
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced newcomer uses superior class and tactical awareness to overcome the pace dynamics. Quality horses with versatile running styles can adapt to any scenario that unfolds.

watchPoints.text: Gesayed must be monitored early - if she gets too easy a lead the front-runner could prove difficult to peg back
Machadadorp's market support will reveal connections' confidence in this unraced newcomer's debut readiness
Light Dreamer's positioning will be crucial as she could get caught between prominent and hold-up horses tactically
Lyrics Of Life needs clear running room in the straight given her hold-up style and tendency to need space
So Regal's early positioning under Moore will indicate whether she presses the leader or waits with tactical cover

races.paceDynamic: Colombier is the lone confirmed front-runner returning from a 475-day break, likely to set an uncontested lead with Storm Star and Dingle the only other forward types but both preferring prominent rather than leading roles. This creates a sustainable pace scenario where the leader won't be pressured early, allowing the large contingent of hold-up horses (Angel Hunter, Greek Order, Tilted Kilt, Saytarr, Dosman, Joolianoss, Dapper Guest) to get into contention. With no pace pressure and a straight mile at Ascot favouring patient rides, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best turn of foot in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Colombier breaks cleanly and isn't pressed by the prominent runners early
scenarios.body: The returning front-runner gets an easy lead and kick for home before the closers can organize their challenge. Storm Star and Dingle sit close enough to capitalize if the leader weakens but the soft pace suits all forward runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady and multiple closers get clear runs in the straight
scenarios.body: Angel Hunter, Saytarr, and Dosman all arrive with late runs as Colombier's long absence tells in the final furlong. The lack of early pace allows these types to unleash their best finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Stalker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Storm Star or Dingle press Colombier enough to soften him up without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The stalking horses get the perfect position to strike when the leader weakens, having avoided both the early pace battle and the traffic problems that could hinder the hold-up brigade. Storm Star's class edge becomes decisive from this tactical position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Colombier goes very slowly early and all runners bunch up turning for home
scenarios.body: A messy finish where positioning and luck in running become crucial as multiple horses hit the line together. The race becomes a lottery with any horse capable of prevailing in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Colombier's fitness after 475 days off - if he shows any signs of blowing up early, the race dynamic changes completely
The pace through the first half-mile - if it goes too slowly, the hold-up horses will bunch up and create traffic problems
Storm Star's early positioning - if he decides to press Colombier early, it could set up the race for the closers
Angel Hunter getting a clear run in the straight - his hold-up style needs luck in running to be effective
How many of the hold-up horses can get organized for one run - with so many closers, some will inevitably get in each other's way
